notes.title: Shopping Center Tycoon: Medieval Items Update
notes.content:
Hello, I hope you're having a good day.

With this Update, I have added a new mode to the game. You will now be able to sell Medieval items in your market. There is no damage to the current save files, but if you want to play in Medieval mode, you will need to start a new game.

Items coming to the game with this update:

1. Shield
2. Knife
3. Sword
4. Crossbow
5. Battle Axe
6. Hammer
7. Mage Staff
8. Helmet
9. Armour
10. Glove
11. Boot


In addition, the inability to place the same product, which was added to the game with the last update, has been removed because it caused an error. Fixed two bugs in decorations bought with tokens.

I will add new achievements for this mode in the next update. I didn't want to postpone the update just because of the achievements as I'm working with excitement. I hope you'll excuse my excitement. Thank you for your support so far. If you want to support me extra, you can support me by writing a review.

Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR

notes.title: Shopping Center Tycoon : Zoom In&Out And Shortcuts Update
notes.content:
Hello, I hope you're having a good day.

Today, after a total of 20-25 hours of experimentation and research, I finally added zoom in and zoom out to the game. As easy as it looks, it was very difficult for me to make it. I hope it was able to meet your expectations. If you want to support me and spoil me a bit, please feel free to write a review. Thank you <3

[Numpad +] : Zoom In
[Numpad -] : Zoom Out
[ALT + ENTER] : Fullscreen Selection

notes.title: Shopping Center Tycoon : 5 New Decoration
notes.content:
Hello, I hope you are having a good day.

With this update, 5 new decorations have been added to the game. These decorations are bought with the "Customer Token" and give beauty points to your market. 

Requests :

[olist]
 Brown Icon = 1x Customer Token
 Grey Icon = 10x Customer Token
 Blue Icon = 100x Customer Token
 Green Icon = 1000x Customer Token
 Yellow Icon = 10000x Customer Token
[/olist]

Benefits :

[olist]
 Brown Icon = 500 Points
 Grey Icon = 1,500 Points
 Blue Icon = 3,000 Points
 Green Icon = 10,000 Points
 Yellow Icon = 100,000x Points
[/olist]

notes.title: Shopping Center Tycoon : Difficulty Mode Update and Achievements
notes.content:
With this update, 3 difficulty levels have been added to the game, each difficulty level will allow you to change the rates and prices of taxes and upgrades, allowing you to build a market in the consistency you want. 

A total of 18 Achievements have also been added for the Hard Level.

Fixed a visual bug when the tutorial was open.

Thank you for your support, if you would like to support me further, please don't forget to write a review and share your ideas with me via the "Community Hub". Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Shopping Center Tycoon : Will Be Released On February 27th!
notes.content:
Greetings, 

My game Shopping Center Tycoon will be released on February 27th, it's a very exciting wait for me and I wanted to share this excitement with you.

It's been a really long development journey for me. Part of this adventure is now complete. Although I think my game has enough content now, I plan to add new content.

Let me tell you about the newly added content : 

* I added three new maps.
* I added a new path-finding algorithm so there is a chance for more product sales.
* I added new customer face effects.
* I added new NPCs and effects.

I solved the bugs and extra overlooked bugs in the demo. To mention briefly : 

* I fixed the bug where the carpets go out of the map in window mode and close the game.

* I fixed the game closing bug that occurs in product refill.

* Fixed some visual bugs when switching to a new game after a saved game.

I hope you enjoy my game, if you want to contact me please feel free to open a topic in the "Community Hub". I have also added the e-mail address below where you can reach me for your ideas.

E-mail : 
gungor.works@gmail.com

If you are interested in my game, please don't forget to add it to your wishlist (Thanks <3)
